title: Whafful's Crimson to Poplar
description: Changes crimson to be the new poplar wood.
body:
This resource pack retextures crimson wood to have the upcoming poplar wood textures, allowing players to play with the new 26.3 block sets before they're officially available. Everything crimson wood related is changed including its sapling.


![Poplar Wood Set](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d0e18e2c656dc4f58f47407401a95e96b70f3db4.png)


Disclaimer:
These textures were recreated by me based on screenshots and previews of upcoming Minecraft content. While the textures themselves are my own work, they are closely based on designs originally created by Mojang Studios, and I do not claim ownership of the underlying block designs or concepts. This project is an unofficial fan-made resource pack and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mojang Studios or Microsoft.
